description: Full domain intelligence via RDAP (the registries' official WHOIS successor): registration and expiry dates with computed age, registrar, EPP status codes, nameservers, DNSSEC — plus derived risk flags (newly registered, hold status, expiring) and a clean availability answer for unregistered domains. Registry data, structured JSON, no scraping. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.
